notes: Red is expected: the gate reports exactly the eight new test cases failing with NotImplementedError (the stubs), no other admin-api failure. The existing tests call require_agent_principal/check_agent_key directly with short fixture keys (mk_agent_ + 24 chars) and must keep passing unchanged (test paths are frozen), so the exact-shape rejection needs to happen at the /v1/agent route layer, not inside those shared functions. The new tests require the route guard to run before require_agent_principal, to acquire a non-blocking slot from agent_key_guard.agent_verify_capacity(), to set the per-request path away from the internal _verify_semaphore, and to release the slot after the response. Under a full agent capacity, validate_agent_key must still return 200 (test 2); with the internal semaphore full, a valid agent request must still return 200 (test 3).

title: 1.2 Feedback FB-002 (behaviour): The target check of an agent-supplied URL is bounded in time and hol... (F-c16d7dab; C-3f78eec5)

notes: The fake session models a real AsyncSession: a connection opens on the first statement and is returned on commit/rollback. The slow resolver records that state on entry, so the tests assert the request holds no connection while it waits. The update case reads the stored row to know the target changed; the green fix must therefore end that transaction before resolving (e.g. commit and re-lock), or the connection assertion will fail. Both base_url and openapi_url are covered on create and update.

suppressions.reason: the service packages are imported after sys.path setup, matching the other agent-route test files

notes: The resolver bound is RESOLVE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 5.0 in mintkey_models.egress, comfortably under the test's 6s ceiling. On PATCH the route commits the read-only lock/read transaction before awaiting the resolver, then re-sets the tenant context, re-locks the row FOR UPDATE, and re-derives changed fields so the write still happens under the lock with a fresh row.

title: 1.3 Feedback FB-003 (behaviour): service.credential.set matches its schema (F-5af045b0; C-50c7880c)

notes: The new test is tests/unit/admin_api/test_agent_credential_audit_event.py::test_C_50c7880c_credential_set_event_targets_the_service_and_validates. note: no usage window in the answer

question: agent-service-routes-fix-1/Q-001
reason: The criterion's own wording ("longer than the stored column allows") delegates the maximum to the schema. The changelog 004-services.yaml declares display_name VARCHAR(256) and description, base_url, openapi_url TEXT; no later changeset alters these columns (no modifyDataType in the changelog dir), and the mintkey_models mirror agrees. The operator models and the agent body models declare no max_length, and the egress check caps only DNS label length, so no other bound exists for the three TEXT fields. The feedback FB-004 motivating the clause names only an over-long display_name reaching the database. Hence only display_name has a finite column limit; the rest of the clause is vacuous and stays unasserted. This needs no business decision, only reading the schema.

checked.claim: display_name is the only one of the four fields with a finite column length, 256 characters.
description is a TEXT column with no length limit.
base_url is a TEXT column with no length limit.
